run_clean_texts: run the script to clean text files by removing entries without matching FLAC audio files
run_get_args: run the get_args function to parse the dataset directory path from command line arguments
clean_txt_entries: clean text transcript files by keeping only lines with matching FLAC sibling files in the same directory
filter_transcripts_by_audio: filter transcript text files to remove entries that do not have corresponding FLAC audio files
review_clean_texts: review the clean_texts script that removes orphaned transcript entries from LibriSpeech dataset directories
